verification.note: Reproduced by reading the code. frontend/src/lib/shortcuts.ts:85-89 defines UNSHIFTED_PUNCTUATION, a table keyed by US shifted characters. shortcuts.ts:107-112 applies it when shiftKey is held with the primary modifier or Alt. ShortcutsProvider.tsx:81 is the only production caller of normalizeKey, found by grep. The match loop at :99-109 compares every context's s.key against that one normalized string. A grep for ctrl/alt Shift bindings finds exactly the three the reader cites: GlobalSearch.tsx:166 and :188 (ctrl+shift+f), addons/knowledge/frontend/Editor.tsx:1151 (ctrl+shift+k) and Editor.tsx:1170 (ctrl+shift+\\). No invariants.md exists under docs/process/reviews/fix-shift-punctuation-shortcut/, which holds only decisions.md and r1/{head,expected,classification,fixes}, so no touch-point list is declared. The only other ctrl binding on a punctuation key, FileDetailShell.tsx:124 ctrl+\\, has no Shift and is unaffected because shiftInChord is false.

frontend/src/lib/__tests__/shortcuts.test.ts:184-210 resolves the frontend root, lists ../addons/*/frontend plus src, and drops empty or missing roots. sourceFiles (:175-182) skips node_modules and __tests__. The test matches /\bkey:\s*("(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*")/g and keeps chords that contain shift+ and end in a non-letter. Line 218 is the only guard against a vacuous pass: expect(chords.length).toBeGreaterThan(0). Today that set has one member (ctrl+shift+\\ from Editor.tsx:1170), so the guard holds only while the addon binding exists. No touch-point list names these trees, because no invariants file exists for this review.

specification_compliance: The behaviour docs/process/reviews/fix-shift-punctuation-shortcut/decisions.md describes (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+\\ cycles the view, ctrl+shift+f and ctrl+shift+k still work, bare ? opens the cheat sheet) matches normalizeKey at shortcuts.ts:98-117, read statically.
potential_unspecified_behavior: Alt+Shift chords also go through UNSHIFTED_PUNCTUATION. On macOS, Option changes e.key to a different character, so an alt+shift+<punct> binding would not match. No such binding exists today.
regression_risks: Any Ctrl/Alt+Shift chord bound in core or in an addon now normalizes the shifted punctuation back to the US unshifted face. A binding written with the shifted character (for example ctrl+shift+|) would silently stop matching. No such binding exists at this commit.
test_coverage: shortcuts.test.ts:60-83 covers primary+Shift+\\ on Mac and Win, Shift-only | and ctrl+shift+f.
shortcuts.test.ts:214-231 scans source for Shift punctuation chords. It finds only one chord today (ctrl+shift+\\ in the knowledge addon).
